title: Remove Engram Defer decision handling once Engram w-b7190f794266 stops producing it
outcome: Turn-gate simplification (Engram::Opus relay, mailbox #200). Engram removes the defer decision and the refusal codes it can never produce; recovery turns and recovery_required are also gone. TermAl has no recovery_required handling, so nothing to remove there, and Engram's recovery-turn item w-dcd85dacb399 is superseded. TermAl does have Defer handling: EngramTurnDecisionResponse::Defer, EngramDispatchEvaluation::Defer, EngramControlCardDecision::Defer, and the retry disposition in engram_queued_admission.rs. Remove it after Engram::Opus lists the removed variants and codes, before install. Refusal codes are strings in TermAl and need no change.
